name: Exp_wlxBWWiseMan-2
summary: This EA trades based on the wlxBWWiseMan-2 custom indicator, which is part of the Bill Williams trading system (Wiseman-2 signal). It opens buy positions on upward wisdom signals and sell positions on downward signals, with optional counter-position closing based on historical signal scanning. Position sizing uses a money management module from TradeAlgorithms.mqh with configurable margin modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于wlxBWWiseMan-2自定义指标进行交易，该指标属于比尔·威廉姆斯交易系统（智者2号信号）。在出现上行智慧信号时开多仓，下行信号时开空仓，并可通过历史信号扫描选择性地平掉反向仓位。仓位管理使用TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的资金管理模块，支持多种保证金模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA基于比尔·威廉姆斯的智者2号（BWWiseMan-2）信号进行交易，属于比尔·威廉姆斯混沌交易体系的一部分。入场条件：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上出现非零且非空值时触发买入信号，当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）出现非零且非空值时触发卖出信号。出场条件分为两种：一是基于反向信号的出场，即买入信号触发卖出平仓、卖出信号触发买入平仓；二是历史信号扫描出场，当同时启用买入和卖出开仓及平仓时，EA会向后扫描历史K线寻找更早的反向信号来决定是否平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数和MMMode模式控制，支持按自由保证金、余额、亏损后保证金、亏损后余额或固定手数五种模式。止损和止盈分别设为1000和2000点，属于较宽的止损范围，适合H4等较大周期。EA还使用IsNewBar机制确保每个K线只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA trades based on the Bill Williams Wiseman-2 (BWWiseMan-2) signal, which is part of the Bill Williams Chaos Trading system. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the indicator's upper buffer (buffer 1) shows a non-zero and non-empty value on the specified signal bar, and a sell signal is triggered when the lower buffer (buffer 0) shows a non-zero and non-empty value. Exit conditions come in two forms: first, reverse-signal exits where a buy signal triggers sell position closing and vice versa; second, historical signal scanning exits where when both buy/sell open and close are enabled, the EA scans backward through historical bars to find earlier reverse signals to decide whether to close positions. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter and MMMode, supporting five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, loss-free-margin-based, loss-balance-based, or fixed lot size. Stop loss and take profit are set to 1000 and 2000 points respectively, which are wide stops suitable for larger timeframes like H4. The EA also uses the IsNewBar mechanism to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Lot calculation mode (Free Margin/Balance/Net Margin Loss/Net Balance Loss/Fixed Lot)

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否开启买入平仓（反向信号时）

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否开启卖出平仓（反向信号时）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引

pros: 使用比尔·威廉姆斯成熟交易体系的信号，具有理论依据
提供五种仓位管理模式，灵活性较高
具有IsNewBar新K线检测机制，避免同一K线重复交易
买入和卖出的开仓/平仓开关独立可控，便于灵活配置策略
设有止损和止盈，具备基本的风险控制
pros_en: Uses signals from the well-established Bill Williams trading system, providing theoretical basis
Offers five position sizing modes with high flexibility
Implements IsNewBar mechanism to prevent duplicate trades on the same bar
Buy and sell open/close switches are independently controllable for flexible strategy configuration
Includes stop loss and take profit settings for basic risk control
cons: 历史信号扫描出场逻辑存在缺陷——只要在历史中找到任何一个反向信号就平仓，可能导致过早平仓
依赖外部指标wlxBWWiseMan-2和TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，缺少这些文件EA将无法运行
没有点差过滤、交易时间过滤或市场波动性过滤，可能在不利条件下开仓
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未根据市场波动率动态调整
缺少持仓数量检查，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
cons_en: Historical signal scanning exit logic is flawed—closes position upon finding any single reverse signal in history, potentially causing premature exits
Depends on external indicator wlxBWWiseMan-2 and TradeAlgorithms.mqh library; EA cannot run without these files
No spread filter, trading session filter, or market volatility filter; may open positions under unfavorable conditions
Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are fixed values, not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility
Missing position count check; may open duplicate positions in the same direction
improvements: 添加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓
增加点差过滤和市场波动性自适应止损止盈机制
优化历史信号扫描出场逻辑，应基于最近的有效反向信号而非历史中任意一个信号
improvements_en: Add position check logic to avoid opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Add spread filter and market volatility-adaptive stop loss/take profit mechanism
Optimize historical signal scanning exit logic to base decisions on the most recent valid reverse signal rather than any signal in history

risk_points: 缺少持仓数量检查，可能导致同方向重复开仓增加风险敞口
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性，在高波动市场中止损可能过窄
历史信号扫描出场逻辑可能过早平掉盈利仓位
risk_points_en: Missing position count check may lead to duplicate same-direction positions increasing risk exposure
Fixed stop loss/take profit does not account for market volatility; stops may be too narrow in high-volatility markets
Historical signal scanning exit logic may prematurely close profitable positions
